Card Q&A.q: Does the effect of this Tamer stack if there are multiple copies in play in my battle area?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. It doesn't affect normal Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Does this Tamer's effect only affect Security Digimon?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] All of your Security Digimon get +2000 DP.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
